signals.architecture_freetext: HBM growing faster than conventional DRAM through 2028; HBM3E to HBM4 to HBM4E transition with increasing trade ratios constraining bit growth; custom NVHBM co-design with NVIDIA for HBM4E; agentic AI workloads driving CPU-attached DRAM demand alongside accelerator HBM.
